entities.title: Specification
entities.summary: The normative specification of UTV 1.0, the source of truth for what values and results mean.
entities.purpose: Defines the temporal data model: the core model and standards convergence (SPECIFICATION.md, Parts I and II), the binding design decisions and implementation obligations (DECISIONS.md), the result contract (RESULT-CONTRACT.md), coverage of published standards (STANDARDS-MATRIX.md) and the falsehood traceability matrix (FALSEHOODS-MATRIX.md). OPEN-ISSUES.md holds the precedence rule for open issues and points at their records.
boundaries: Governs semantics; the JSON Schema in schema/ governs only serialized field names and shapes.
A design specification for independently implemented engines, not an ISO or IETF standard.
Versioned with the schema and the conformance material under one version number (VERSIONING.md).
